chunks: Each soul will know what it had sent ahead and what it had left behind.

key_terms.أَخَّرَتْ: Left behind, referring to good deeds missed or bad deeds accumulated
key_terms.قَدَّمَتْ: Sent ahead, referring to good deeds performed and preserved
key_terms.نَفْسٌ: Soul or self, referring to the individual being judged

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about individual accountability on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the immediacy of individual accountability, where the soul witnesses its own deeds without external mediation, reflecting the concept of *'Ilm al-Ghayb* (God's knowledge) manifesting to the self. It emphasizes that the 'forwarded' deeds are those actively performed and preserved, while 'postponed' or 'left behind' deeds may refer to neglected obligations or good deeds deferred until their due time, highlighting the precision of divine justice.
